title: AHB WRAP4 Critical-Word-First Sequence
description: A word-sized WRAP4 starts at 0x38, reaches 0x3C, wraps to the 16-byte region base at 0x30, and finishes at 0x34.

annotations.message: The critical word at 0x38 is requested first. Four words occupy 16 bytes, so this burst is confined to the aligned 0x30–0x3F region.
The second address increments normally to 0x3C while data for 0x38 completes.
Wrap event: adding four would leave the 16-byte region, so the address returns to its aligned base at 0x30.
The final address 0x34 completes coverage of every word in the cache-line-sized region.
The last data beat completes one cycle after the final address phase.
